Method of Attack: Inclusion of a password recovery tool (WebBrowserPassView) to steal credentials
Exfiltration of stolen credentials to a remote server via HTTP requests
Deletion of evidence by removing password recovery output after submission
Impacted Systems: Systems where the bb-builder package was installed
Browsers storing credentials (Internet Explorer, Mozilla Firefox, Google Chrome, Safari, Opera)
Attack Vector: Supply chain attack via compromised developer account
Typosquatting to mislead developers into installing the package
